Description: Infection of susceptible humans by an infectious mosquito, leading to clinical disease with a probability (w) dependent on anti-disease immunity.
Infection of susceptible humans by an infectious mosquito, leading to asymptomatic patent infection with a probability (1-w) dependent on anti-disease immunity.
Successful treatment of clinical disease with a fixed probability (fT).
Natural recovery from untreated clinical disease to become patently asymptomatic at rate rD.
Superinfection of an individual with untreated clinical disease, leading to a new clinical disease episode.
Progression from patent to sub-patent asymptomatic infection at a rate (rA) that depends on anti-parasite immunity.
Superinfection of an individual with asymptomatic patent infection, leading to a new clinical disease episode.
Superinfection of an individual with asymptomatic patent infection, leading to a new asymptomatic patent infection.
Clearing of infection following treatment, entering a period of prophylactic protection at rate rT.
Loss of prophylactic protection and return to susceptibility at rate rP.
Clearing of sub-patent infection and return to full susceptibility at rate rU.
Superinfection of an individual with asymptomatic sub-patent infection, leading to a new clinical disease episode.
Superinfection of an individual with asymptomatic sub-patent infection, leading to a new asymptomatic patent infection.
Infection of a susceptible mosquito from biting an infectious human (from states T, D, A, or U).
Progression of a mosquito from the latent to the infectious state after an extrinsic incubation period.

Name: L
Description: Force of infection in the human population.

Name: w
Description: Probability of developing clinical disease upon infection, dependent on the individual's level of anti-disease immunity.

Name: fT
Description: Fixed probability of being treated successfully for clinical disease.

Name: rT
Description: Rate at which successfully treated individuals clear infection and enter a period of prophylactic protection.

Name: rP
Description: Rate at which individuals under prophylaxis return to being susceptible to new infection.

Name: rD
Description: Rate at which individuals with untreated clinical disease clear disease and become patently asymptomatic.

Name: rA
Description: Rate at which individuals with patent asymptomatic infection move to a sub-patent stage, dependent on anti-parasite immunity.

Name: rU
Description: Rate at which sub-patent infection is cleared and individuals return to being fully susceptible.

Name: HBI
Description: Human Blood Index, the proportion of mosquito blood meals taken from humans, which determines infectivity.
